title: Does anyone have music playing while they're in the mall world?
content: I can't believe I found this sub. I have tried so long to find others who experience the same dreams as me. Literally my entire life. When I go to my dreamscapes I always have a song playing in the background. Sometimes I know the song and other times they're bangers I've never heard of that I didn't even know my mind could create. Anyone else experience this?
